benefits: Cryptographically secure random values, not a weak formula.
Optional unique values for draws and lotteries.

faqs.a: It uses the Web Crypto API (crypto.getRandomValues) with rejection sampling, so every value in the range is equally likely and the sequence is unpredictable.
No. Computer-generated randomness is fine for games, draws and sampling, but regulated lotteries and cryptography have stricter requirements.
faqs.q: Can I use it for a real lottery?

faqs.a: Yes. Turn on 'No repeats' and every number appears at most once, like drawing names from a hat.
faqs.q: Can I get numbers without repeats?

faqs.a: Up to 100 numbers per draw. Set the count field to anything from 1 to 100.
faqs.q: How many numbers can I generate at once?

faqs.a: Turn off 'No repeats'. Then each draw is independent and duplicates are allowed.

random-number-generator.formula:
Each value is drawn uniformly from [min, max]
using crypto.getRandomValues with rejection sampling

keyFacts: Every number in the range has exactly the same chance of appearing.

limitations: Not suitable for regulated gambling or cryptographic keys.
Only whole numbers — no random decimals.

random-number-generator.privacyNote: This tool runs 100% in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.
random-number-generator.quickAnswer: A random number generator picks integers where every value in your range is equally likely. Set a minimum and maximum, choose how many numbers you want, and press generate. The tool uses your browser's secure crypto random source, so the results are fair and unpredictable.
random-number-generator.tagline: Fair random integers for draws, games and decisions.
random-number-generator.workedExample:
You need 5 raffle winners from tickets numbered 1 to 100.

Set min = 1, max = 100, count = 5, and turn on 'No repeats'.

Press Generate. Suppose the draw shows 12, 34, 56, 78, 90.

These are the five winning tickets — each was equally likely to appear.
